generated_for: TASK-FUT-004 — Futuris walk-forward forecast evaluation harness (Futuris/futuris/evaluation/walkforward.py)
rules: Every series the harness scores is listed here with its source and the sha256 of the exact file scored.
The harness refuses to score a file whose sha256 does not match this manifest.
Raw downloads are preserved under raw/ so every transformation below is independently auditable.
The synthetic series is labelled synthetic everywhere it appears; it is never presented as measured data.

source.name: AirPassengers — monthly airline passenger numbers (thousands), 1949-1960
source.origin: Box & Jenkins (1976) time-series dataset, distributed with R as datasets::AirPassengers

series.transformation: Raw file carries decimal-year timestamps (1949, 1949.0833, ...); normalized to monthly dates 1949-01-01..1960-12-01. Values unchanged (integers).

source.name: DEXUSEU — Euro Area / U.S. Dollar exchange rate (U.S. dollars to one euro), daily, not seasonally adjusted
source.origin: Federal Reserve Statistical Release H.10 via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

series.transformation: Trimmed to the complete window 2022-01-01..2025-12-31; 43 in-window rows carrying '.' (FRED missing-value marker, holidays) dropped; values otherwise unchanged. Business days only, so the seasonal period is the 5-day trading week.

series.purpose: Matches Futuris's production operating shape (non-negative 5-minute telemetry, daily season 288) so the harness exercises the adapters' production season length. It is a machinery/protocol fixture, not evidence about any real service.

source.name: Synthetic 5-minute service telemetry (requests-per-minute shape)
source.origin: Generated in-repo by evaluation_data/generate_synthetic_telemetry.py, numpy default_rng(PCG64) seed 42

series.transformation: None — the vendored CSV is the generator's direct output (deterministic; regeneration reproduces the sha256 above).
